nodes.label: Smoother First Run (example/Si + vasp-auto --init)
nodes.rationale: A fresh clone could not run the README Quickstart: it pointed at git-ignored inputs/Fe and example/ shipped only INCAR templates, so the first command failed 'target not found'; with no config.yaml the engine fell back to bare defaults that fail cryptically. Ships example/Si/POSCAR and --init to copy config.yaml.example.

nodes.label: Resume Unfinished Job In Place (CONTCAR to POSCAR, warm WAVECAR/CHGCAR)
nodes.rationale: Restart a job from the latest geometry VASP wrote without allocating a new NNNN job number or rebuilding inputs; reuses the job dir's own INCAR/KPOINTS/POTCAR, only POSCAR advances. Works local, ssh, and detached-offload (setsid so the host can power off).

nodes.label: Working-case UI Model
nodes.rationale: Whatever the user builds, imports or saves becomes the single working case that Calculate/Workflow/Remote all act on, replacing the old cases-folder + case-select pair.

nodes.label: Shared Machine List (config_loader.load_ui_remotes)
nodes.rationale: One source of truth for remotes: load_ui_remotes folds the UI's remotes.json into the CLI config so --remote NAME sees machines added in the UI, avoiding drift.
